searchText: I wanted to flag this PR adding BAL methods to the json rpc: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/726 First, were there any updates in the RPC standard calls, and second, what's the status of it wrt merging it? Nothing on the call, but if you think its good to merge now then I think <@372731338031366165> <@194432762315407360> needs to have a pass on it also am not current on whats the status on the .io files in it? Yeah clients will have the latest of the PR implemented for devnet-3 but we wanted to make sure it's aligned with how people with more expertise on the json rpc. From the BAL side, it's ready to be merged. I think rpctestgen needs to be updated to support eth_getBlockAccessList - the tests appear to be manually generated? But I think that also means we have to advance the chain in hive? Might need <@194432762315407360> help there I have a PR that updates the docs to better describe the steps required to generate the tests: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/759 We might need to merge the spec in first, and deal with the tests later 🤔 then the .io files needs to be removed if geth has this method in already it will be nice to run the test so the .io files can be properly generated or we can skip the .io files for now and get the spec in Even if geth has it merged, the hive test chain needs to have blocks in the new fork with BALs available to test to generate meaniningful .io files. So probably we just remove the test files for now. Have to refer to <@427903869226582018> for that yep! it's in the devnet 2 branch I can create this pr today I checked this we have eth name space already but the issue is docker images get pulled from main not devnet 2 branch so am not sure of a way out Yes, the test chain would have to be updated for BAL
